container.source: Statistics Centre - Abu Dhabi (SCAD), Annual National Accounts 2024, Table 1 'GDP 2014-2024 at current prices' (AED 1,132,652 million); population: SCAD Abu Dhabi Population Trends 2024
container.notes: City population = Abu Dhabi Region (2,823,340 in 2024; Abu Dhabi City Municipality's capital region incl. island, mainland suburbs, Musaffah, MBZ City); emirate total 4,135,985 (Abu Dhabi region + Al Ain 986,910 + Al Dhafra 325,735), so the city is ~68% of the emirate's population. Widely quoted 'AED 1.2 trillion in 2024' is REAL (constant 2014 prices) — do not use. Per capita ~AED 274k (~US$75k), plausible for an oil emirate.
